notes.title: 3RD ANNIVERSARY UPDATE
notes.notes:
After three years, for every game I make, there will be a final mercy update, which will focus on a small bonus, and a final bunch of bug fixings.

First I'll explain the bonus

ＰＲＡＶＤＡ V1.1
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39243482/3c6a14159ffbc93ef0d9f1334979c48b0155eda6.png

The scarlet witch, imprisoned between an infinite palace has been awakened. Alphariel has a final test for you.

Without your powers, you must kill the brutally elegant Pravda to escape this pocket dimension and get the PRAVDA achievement.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39243482/eab44174bfeb42db54d1b65593899c7bf03dfee3.gif

Now, the fun stuff. V3.7.2.3
The update comes with two extra executable that can be opened at launch.
Pravda and trophy launcher
On earlier versions the game did not support achievements, they were programmed, but the addon did not link to the steam API, so with this new update, you can launch the trophy loader, to claim your achievements after playing the game.
This only applies after the new update.

The other is Pravda, which launches the Pravda game, it can also be launched from the secret tv in the prophets archives level. Although the steam launch is recommended.

Aside from this, the main game has had the most amount of bug fixes as possible. From quality of life, to crashes and save errors.
fixed animations on the wall inside the burned manor
updated steam api to use steamworks of webview2 instead of greenworks
fixed tp in corruptend yelendria
fixed weird black screen position
fixed health of corrupted luna, she killed herself instantly
fixed weird bug inside garden nexo that killed Nyuji
fixed bad positioning of abilities in the hud
corrected spikes hitbox
there is a bug when trying to make the visual novel after completing the corrupted ending
i dont know what to do for that, so, just dont do that.

Too many to list.

But alas. This is the final goodbye.

Thank you for playing.


good night

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39243482/b08ad20a34e79cabe99a00efec2bd416c5e6fb3a.gif

notes.title: DESTINYATA MOE FINAL UPDATE
notes.notes:
This is going to be the lasting update, so two things, optimization, and life quality improvements
First we'll go for the new things
First and most important
new 𝔠𝔞𝔱 𝔤𝔦𝔯𝔩


I decided to abandon any reputation and give the player cat ears and moe

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39243482/efd9cb047f148a1890714a0f9edecdcbf8b350a6.gif

This is simple, Neko spell is an item that can be obtained at the stairs of Prophet Archives level
The spell loads a bullet, that when hits an enemy, it stuns them for a two seconds, and has a reload time of 7 seconds.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39243482/22297f298a3fab0701811a03006e3e65cea50ace.gif

New abilities select panel
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39243482/875408bb844f7507593160348ca88682a3bff00c.gif
Simply use Q and E to change between your actives witout needing to activate the menu

Now we will see all the minor changes and big fixes.

 Optimized the hitbox for several objects
 Cropped excess pixels in sprite animations
 Reduced the amount of HQ sprite images
 Reduced the peak average performance from 8GB to 3.4GB
 Changed minor effects in animations
 Fixed an error that automatically skipped Nyuji when reaching the corrupted ending
 Fixed an error that required having all three endings instead of two to reach the true ending
 Applied a yellow bar effect for all bosses
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39243482/97a522e4d0e6882628c640b86a1c78b4d1c28c45.png
 Deleted several unused objects to facilitate memory
 Fixed a slight disproportion in the health bar of the bosses
 Optimized several animations by manually deleting frames (yes it took me two full days to do that)
 Fixed an error where for some reason weapon images would flatten
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39243482/638a3b05174287ad7bd76920292a60940921e6d2.png
 Fixed an error where Mariae blood spikes would be wider than intended
 Fixed an error with Corrupted Luna where her animations bugged the fixed point
 Reduced Corrupted Yelendria Hp from 9000 to 7500
 Fixed an error at skipping Katyusha's cutscene she wouldn't attack
 Fixed an error where a black screen would scale to a smaller size
 Fixed an error where Katyusha yellow bar would be turned 180°
 Fixed a slight misalignment with Primi health bar and corrupted Yelendria


anyways now you know 💀
